title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff & regional failover ordering under load
author: Marcus Chen
description: Summary: This hotfix addresses a race in the SLO enforcer that caused cascade load-shedding and incorrect regional failover orderings during high load spikes (see ENG-3812). Symptoms observed: two regions concurrently performed aggressive backoff and triggered global load-shedding, leading to elevated error budgets and customer-impacting latency spikes. Root cause: the enforcer's backoff timer and the regional failover coordinator were making independent decisions without a deterministic ordering/lease, allowing overlapping state transitions under contention. Fix: add an ordering gate and lightweight quorum checks to enforcer decisions, introduce jittered backoff windows, and make regional-failover operations idempotent and ordered by a coordination lease. This patch includes unit + integration tests and mitigations to unblock oncall. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce locally with synthetic spike harness - [x] Fix ordering gate in slo-enforcer - [x] Add jitter to backoff timers - [x] Make regional-failover idempotent and add lease guard - [x] Add integration test that simulates concurrent failover + burst - [x] Update Prometheus alerts and dashboard panels Why this change: During last week's incident (INC-998) we saw the enforcer oscillate between regions which amplified shedding. Small windows where both enforcer and failover attempted to act produced conflicting signals. The changes here reduce overlap and make decision-making deterministic while preserving fast failover for genuine region outages.

discussion_summary: Initial failure in CI reproduced flaky interaction between backoff and failover ordering. After tightening the ordering gate and adding jitter, tests stabilized. Reviewers requested extra integration coverage and a dashboard alert which were added. No rollback required after canary rollout to 10%.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer decision ordering under concurrent load. Adds ordering gate, jitter to backoff, idempotent regional-failover with lease guard, new integration tests, and Prometheus alert for overlap rate. Reduces unnecessary load-shedding and prevents cascading regional failovers.
rollback_plan: If regressions observed: revert merge, roll back enforcer helm chart to previous values, re-enable emergency routing to fallback model pool. Run smoke harness and monitor slo_enforcer_overlap_rate metric before promoting.
manual_steps_to_reproduce: 1) Start local spike-harness to flood region-a and region-b simultaneously. 2) Run services/slo-enforcer with old config to observe overlap_rate ~0.1+. 3) Switch to branch head and re-run; expect overlap_rate <0.02 and no double-shedding.
notes_for_oncall: New metric slo_enforcer_overlap_rate (prometheus) and an alert at 0.05 for 5m. If firing, follow runbook: pause new deployments, enable emergency fallback routing, and investigate enforcer decision logs (log tag: slo_enforcer:decision).
